small_density_polynomial.definition: Mean relative pressure loss = a*moved + b*moved^2, zero intercept; descriptive local fit.

disorder.note: Pointwise mean CIs and exponent CIs resample entire seed trajectories; accepted-flip trajectories are not equilibrium draws.

window_vs_moved_rank_advantage.definition: rho(moved,pressure) minus rho(excess,pressure); positive means stronger negative association for window excess.

severity_stratified_permutation.interpretation: Tests additional within-severity association; pooled trend survives even under this null.
